segments.en: Today I practise 计算机英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 身份验证与权限 with a teammate. I use authentication to talk about 身份验证，确认用户是谁的过程. I use authorization to talk about 授权，确认用户可以做什么的过程. I use user account to talk about 用户账号，用来识别和保存个人信息的身份. I tell my teammate: Today I use authentication, authorization, and user account. At the end, I say: I can use authentication clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 计算机英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 身份验证与权限 with a teammate. I use login session to talk about 登录会话，用户登录后持续一段时间的访问状态. I use access permission to talk about 访问权限，允许用户读取或修改某项资源的规则. I use sign out to talk about 退出登录，结束当前登录会话. I tell my teammate: Today I use login session, access permission, and sign out. At the end, I say: I can use login session clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 日常交流英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 看病和药店 with a teammate. I use I don't feel well. to talk about 我感觉不舒服。. I use I have a headache. to talk about 我头痛。. I use How often should I take this? to talk about 这个药多久吃一次？. I tell my teammate: Today I use I don't feel well., I have a headache., and How often should I take this?. At the end, I say: I can use I don't feel well. clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 日常交流英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 看病和药店 with a teammate. I use Are there any side effects? to talk about 有副作用吗？. I use I'm allergic to this medicine. to talk about 我对这种药过敏。. I use I need to see a doctor. to talk about 我需要看医生。. I tell my teammate: Today I use Are there any side effects?, I'm allergic to this medicine., and I need to see a doctor.. At the end, I say: I can use Are there any side effects? clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise github 项目英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about token、secret 与权限 with a teammate. I use access token to talk about 访问令牌，代替密码授权程序访问服务的字符串. I use personal access token to talk about 个人访问令牌，代表个人账号调用 GitHub 的令牌. I use repository secret to talk about 仓库机密，供自动化任务安全使用的敏感值. I tell my teammate: Today I use access token, personal access token, and repository secret. At the end, I say: I can use access token clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise github 项目英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about token、secret 与权限 with a teammate. I use workflow permission to talk about 工作流权限，限制自动化可以执行的操作. I use secret scanning to talk about 机密扫描，自动发现意外提交的密钥. I use revoke a token to talk about 撤销令牌，让已有令牌立即失效. I tell my teammate: Today I use workflow permission, secret scanning, and revoke a token. At the end, I say: I can use workflow permission clearly today.
